en: The Sūtra on the Dhāraṇī for Expelling All Evil Spoken by the Buddha,
translated by the Tripitaka Master of the Western Heaven, the Imperially Appointed Court Dispersing Grandee, Acting Minister of the Court of Imperial Entertainments,
and Great Master of Illuminating Teaching, the Subject Faxian, in accordance with the Imperial Decree.
At that time, the World-Honored One addressed Ānanda, saying:
"I see that when calamities arise in the world,
flying locusts and venomous insects consequently come into being."
Even mosquitoes, gadflies, tigers, and wolves increased in number everywhere,
causing damage to the crops or to vegetables and fruits,
which eventually led to a gradual onset of famine within the kingdom.
They afflict and harm sentient beings, depriving them of peace and security.
I shall now proclaim for you the dhāraṇī that wards off all evils.
If there are sentient beings who recite it with a sincere mind, [they shall be protected].
This benefits not only oneself but others as well.
If a practitioner wishes to perform a rite of accomplishment (*sādhana*),
they must first purify themselves through fasting and precepts, and give rise to a heart of sincere truth.
Once you have recited the dhāraṇī one hundred thousand times and attained full mastery,
you may perform the rite of accomplishment (sādhanā) in any location.
Furthermore, the practitioner who performs the rite must first purify themselves thoroughly.
Nevertheless, one should recite the names of the Buddhas and Bodhisattvas to request their empowerment;
then, taking a small amount of sand and placing it in a clean vessel,
one should recite the dhāraṇī eight hundred times to consecrate the sand.
Scatter [the substances] in places where there are venomous insects;
all venomous insects will be entirely driven away. Then he spoke the dhāraṇī, saying:
*Namaḥ sarvabuddhabodhisattvebhyaḥ*. *Tiṣṭha*. *Hūṃ*. *Phaṭ*. *Svāhā*.
Namo siddhārthāya vimale pradyotaya | jyotir-vimale tiṣṭha | tadyathā | ha ha ha | li li li | caṇ caṇ caṇ ||

Having heard the World-Honored One’s exposition of this *dhāraṇī* for the expulsion of all evils,
they received it with joy and faith, prostrated before the Buddha, and withdrew.
The *Sūtra on the Dhāraṇī for the Expulsion of All Evils* Spoken by the Buddha.
